description: Angular component for configuring a map of key-value pairs with validation, dynamic form controls, and integration with Angular forms API.

classes.name: SvMapConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for managing a configurable list of key-value pairs with validation and dynamic options.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up form controls, and subscribes to value changes.

methods.name: keyValsFormArray
methods.description: Returns the FormArray of key-value controls.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with provided key-value map.

methods.name: filterSelectOptions
methods.description: Filters available options based on current selections.

methods.name: removeKeyVal
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair at specified index.

methods.name: addKeyVal
methods.description: Adds a new key-value pair control.

methods.name: keyChangeSubscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to changes in key control to update value accordingly.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the form data.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the bound model with current form data.
